title: Database Call Logic Schema
description: Schema for the db_call logic type in Corezoid processes

type.description: Specifies this is a Database Call logic block

err_node_id.description: ID of the node for error handling

instance_id.description: ID of the pre-configured database connection instance

query.description: The SQL query to execute. Can include dynamic references like {{user_id}}

params.description: Parameters for the query (for parameterized queries)

chunkify.description: Server-emitted execution flag. Not authored by hand — Corezoid adds it to deployed nodes, so pull-process round-trips carry it back. Declared here so the plugin's own pull -> edit -> lint -> push loop does not fail on its own output.
